name: hrow5_cbh_xb-xb-scratch-COMMIT
purpose: S-ELEM-PQ/HROW 2026-10-16: half chain bank tile dsfd_mtp_hrow_cbh (2 x ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256, 512 data bits) replacing the full-bank cbe/cbw tiles whose clock cannot meet the native rule (cbw closed R 538.5 / spread 89.2; N-centre TritonCTS gate R 406.2 / spread 120.8). Recipe 3 kit (io_flop_at_pins + pin_reg_split + keep_pin_regs + HB2), TritonCTS from the N-face centre, 0 cycles. Pass: TT/FF >= 0, DRC 0, native launch <= 220 / capture <= 190 / spread <= 80 / R <= 300; bench mtp_hrow_gate --uturn --half-banks pos PASS / mut FAIL.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_mtp_hrow_cbh u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/ot_dsrom_mtp_hrow_cbh.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/rtt/ot_dsrom_mtp_rstsync.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hrow5_cbh_xb/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hrow5_cbh_xb/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hrow5_cbh_xb --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_mtp_hrow_cbh --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: NEW master replacing dsfd_mtp_hrow_cbe + dsfd_mtp_hrow_cbw (one master, 2 per bank, 60 per die instead of 30 + ... full-bank tiles): full-bank tiles cannot meet R <= 300 / spread <= 80 (measured: closed cbw spine R 538.5/89.2; TritonCTS W entry 385-501; n1-0030 CTS gate N-centre entry 326.9-447.7, R 406.2, spread 120.8; results/physical/s81_hrow_native_0030/native_audit_s81_hc_hrow_0030.json). Same chain-stage RTL narrowed to 512 data bits; bank pair dsfd_mtp_hrow_cbp is die wiring; 0 cycles (bench --uturn --half-banks cycle-identical).
